newsitem.title: UK: SQUASH-JANSHER AND NICOL MEET IN FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SQUASH-JANSHER AND NICOL MEET IN FINAL.

text.p: Pakistan's top seeded defending champion Jansher Khan resisted a tough challenge from Egypt's Ahmed Barada on Saturday to reach his eighth British Open final.

In Sunday's decider, the world number one will meet third seed Peter Nicol, who earlier on Saturday became the first Scottish finalist of the tournament for 33 years when he beat Australia's Rodney Eyles.
Nicol celebrated his 24th birthday with a 5-15 15-12 17-14 15-2 semi-final victory over the second seed.
Jansher, though, won't be handing out any birthday presents in Cardiff as he goes looking for his sixth successive British Open win.
He started almost nervously against 19-year-old Barada before finally going through 13-15 15-8 15-8 15-4 in an hour and five minutes.
"You could not say I was nervous, but I was a little tense at the start of the game," he admitted.

"You cannot have great games every day. Some days are bad and this was one of my bad days. There is often a bad match for me at the British Open and this time it was in the semi-finals. I expect to play well against Peter," he warned.
